jobs.description:
On behalf of a partner company, Nordic Investin is looking for a Group Accounting and Consolidation Lead. You see finance as both a decision and control function, combining accuracy with the curiosity to turn numbers into action.
The partner is strengthening its capability in dependable group consolidation and technical reporting across entities. You will connect consolidation, IFRS and acquisitions while ensuring that controls and audit receive appropriate discipline. The aim is practical progress that colleagues can use, leaders can evaluate and the organisation can sustain.
Finance values dependable reporting, strong controls and constructive partnership. Success means better decisions and trusted information.
How you will work
You will work with finance colleagues, operational leaders and system owners. The partner values early escalation, transparent assumptions and lasting improvements.
This role calls for visible leadership and disciplined decision making. You are expected to make trade-offs visible, recognise when a decision needs wider expertise and move work forward without creating unnecessary process.
What you will do
Own the practical direction for dependable group consolidation and technical reporting across entities.
Translate goals and constraints into a clear approach for consolidation and IFRS.
Establish useful standards, routines or decision artefacts around acquisitions.
Coordinate stakeholders and dependencies affecting controls.
Use evidence and measurable outcomes to improve audit.
Strengthen knowledge sharing and sustainable ownership through team leadership.
What you will bring
Relevant experience delivering dependable group consolidation and technical reporting across entities in a demanding environment.
Strong working knowledge of consolidation and IFRS.
Practical experience applying acquisitions and controls.
Ability to assess priorities, risks and trade-offs involving audit.
Evidence of clear stakeholder communication and dependable end-to-end ownership.
Professional English and the judgement to work with sensitive or business-critical information.
Experience that would add value
Experience from international groups and listed environments.
Exposure to team leadership in a cross-functional or multi-team environment.
Swedish language skills or experience working across Nordic organisations.
A background that can succeed here
Your background may be group finance, operations, audit, advisory or a growing business. Show the controls and decisions you owned and the outcome. Direct experience of dependable group consolidation and technical reporting across entities is valuable, while adjacent experience counts when it shows transferable judgement.
What makes the opportunity interesting
The role combines professional depth with meaningful business questions and room to improve the processes behind the numbers. The focus on dependable group consolidation and technical reporting across entities gives the opportunity a clear mission and room to influence priorities and success measures.
The exact partner, employment model, compensation, start date and working arrangement will be explained openly during the process. Nordic Investin will make sure you understand the opportunity before asking you to make a decision.
The recruitment conversation
Nordic Investin will focus on decisions you have made: the context, alternatives, result and what you would change today. You will also have room to ask direct questions and test whether the role, mandate and partner environment are right for you.
How to apply
Apply with your CV or LinkedIn profile and a short note about a relevant financial process, decision or transformation you helped improve. Nordic Investin welcomes different routes into the profession and assesses evidence, judgement and potential alongside formal titles.

jobs.occupation: Client Service Associate  Build a Long-Term Career in Finance (London)
jobs.description:
Are you a Swedish speaker looking for an opportunity to develop professionally, learn new skills and build a long-term career within the financial services industry?
Our client, a leading international investment management company, is looking for a motivated and detail-oriented Swedish Client Service Associate to join their growing team.
This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys working behind the scenes, supporting clients and business operations, and is eager to grow within an international organisation. No finance background is required – what matters most is your motivation, willingness to learn and ambition to develop.
The Role
As a Client Service Associate, you will play an important role in supporting the company's daily operations and ensuring a high level of service for its Swedish-speaking clients.
This is primarily a back-office and administrative role, involving collaboration with different teams and financial institutions across Europe.
Your responsibilities will include:
Handling administrative and operational tasks in collaboration with leading banks and financial institutions.
Supporting internal teams with client-related inquiries and daily operations.
Preparing reports and maintaining accurate client information.
Working closely with colleagues across different departments and European markets.
Identifying opportunities to improve processes and contribute new ideas.
Gradually taking on additional responsibilities as you develop within the role.

Career Development
What makes this opportunity particularly interesting is the potential for long-term career growth.
Our client believes in developing talent from within and offers comprehensive training, ongoing support and opportunities to explore different career paths across the business.
You will be encouraged to take initiative, develop new skills and take on greater responsibilities as you progress. Whether your future interests lie in operations, management, analytics or other areas of the business, there are opportunities to shape your own career path.
Our client wants you to grow with the company and chart a course for a rewarding, long-term career.
Your Profile
We are looking for someone who is motivated, organised and genuinely interested in the position and the opportunity it offers.
To be successful in this role, you should have:
Native or fluent Swedish and good English skills, both written and spoken.
A university degree or equivalent combination of education and experience.
Strong communication and organisational skills.
A structured and detail-oriented approach to your work.
A collaborative mindset and the ability to work well within a team.
A proactive attitude and willingness to learn and develop.
An interest in building a long-term career within an international business environment.

A background in finance, economics or business is an advantage but not a requirement.
The Offer
Full-time, permanent position.
Competitive salary and benefits package.
Comprehensive training and ongoing professional development.
A collaborative and international working environment.
Excellent opportunities for internal career progression.
The chance to build a rewarding, long-term career within a growing international organisation.

Location: London, United Kingdom (office-based).
Interested?
If you are a Swedish speaker looking for more than just your next job, and are excited about the opportunity to learn, develop and grow within an international company, we would love to hear from you!
Apply today and take the next step towards building your future career.

Own the practical direction for market-informed pay structures and consistent compensation decisions.
Translate goals and constraints into a clear approach for job evaluation and salary benchmarking.

Coordinate stakeholders and dependencies affecting analytics.
Use evidence and measurable outcomes to improve governance.

Practical experience applying pay ranges and analytics.

Evidence of clear stakeholder communication and dependable end-to-end ownership.
Professional English and the judgement to work with sensitive or business-critical information.

Experience from international organisations and growing companies.
Exposure to stakeholder advice in a cross-functional or multi-team environment.
Swedish language skills or experience working across Nordic organisations.

Your background may be in-house, advisory, shared services or consulting. What matters is how you owned decisions, balanced needs and improved outcomes. The role gives you access to meaningful organisational questions and the people who can act on them. The focus on market-informed pay structures and consistent compensation decisions gives the opportunity a clear mission and room to influence priorities and success measures.
The exact partner, employment model, compensation, start date and working arrangement will be explained openly during the process. Nordic Investin will make sure you understand the opportunity before asking you to make a decision.

Be part of Clavister's journey to secure the digital world. We are looking for an experienced Back-End Developer to join our IAM engineering team in Stockholm, developing products for authentication, identity management and digital signing.

Clavister is a European cybersecurity company founded in 1997 and headquartered in Örnsköldsvik. We develop solutions across network security, identity and access management, cloud security, machine learning and AI for customers in the public sector, critical infrastructure, defence and telecommunications. With our partners and distributors, our hardware and software are deployed in more than 100 countries.
The role
As a Back-End Developer in our IAM team, you will design, develop and maintain Java-based server-side software that supports secure authentication, identity management and digital signing.
You will work with established products that continue to evolve as customer needs, security requirements and technology change. This means balancing new functionality with reliability, performance, maintainability and technical debt.
You will be part of a collaborative engineering team where technical discussions, shared ownership and continuous improvement are important parts of everyday work.
Key responsibilities
Design, develop and maintain Java-based backend services and applications.

Contribute to technical design and architectural decisions.

Develop secure, reliable and maintainable software with a focus on long-term product quality.

Investigate and resolve complex technical issues, including performance and reliability challenges.

Identify and address technical debt while balancing new development with improvements to existing products.

Collaborate with engineers, architects, Product Management and Customer Success to deliver customer value.

Contribute to engineering practices such as code reviews, automated testing and continuous improvement.

To thrive in this role we believe you have
Several years of professional experience in Java backend development and a strong understanding of the Java ecosystem.

Experience developing asynchronous or concurrent software.

Working knowledge of SQL and relational databases.

Experience working with Docker and containerised applications.

Familiarity with both Windows and Linux environments.

An understanding of software design, maintainability and quality.

A collaborative mindset, curiosity and the ability to take ownership of technical challenges.

Professional working proficiency in English, both written and spoken.

Extra points for
Experience with IAM, authentication, authorisation, identity management or digital signing solutions.

Experience designing and developing complex enterprise software products.

Familiarity with security-related technologies, protocols or integrations.

Frontend development experience using HTML, CSS, JavaScript/TypeScript or React.

What we offer
Meaningful work developing cybersecurity products that protect digital identities and critical services.

The opportunity to work with experienced engineers on technically challenging, established software products.

A collaborative environment where knowledge sharing, technical discussions and continuous learning are encouraged.

The opportunity to influence technical solutions and contribute to the long-term evolution of our IAM portfolio.

A supportive team culture that values work–life balance and sustainable software development.

Join us
If you enjoy solving complex technical challenges, developing reliable software and contributing to products that make a real difference, we'd love to hear from you.
The position is based in Stockholm. We review applications and interview qualified candidates continuously.

About us
Within Data, AI & Automation at E.ON, we bring together data engineering, automation and AI to create smarter ways of working and turn data into solutions that create real value across the business.

build and develop scalable data pipelines and data products using Databricks, Python and SQL
work with data transformation, integration and event-driven solutions
ensure high standards for data quality, security, testing and maintainability
contribute to technical design and continuously improve our engineering practices

jobs.description:

Ericsson AB
Job description:   About this opportunity    Ericsson’s Early Career Program is an 18-month journey for you who are recently graduated or have up to five years of relevant experience. Through three rotations, including one international and market exposure, you will tackle challenges that matter, work alongside people who expect you to contribute, question, and move things forward.  
  
 The Innovate track is designed for you who are driven by building what’s next. You’ll rotate across Research, Product Development, Data, and AI contributing to solutions that don’t just support the business but move it forward.  
  
 This isn’t a program where you sit on the sidelines. From day one, you’re hired into a role, trusted to contribute, supported to grow, and expected to make an impact. Find out more about the Early Career program here.  
  
 Your journey within the Early Career Program will start as a Software Quality & Test Lead in Global Radio Unit Software (RU SW).

You’ll work with experienced colleagues to connect software engineering and AI, and find smarter ways to build, verify and deliver software. 
  
  Explore end-to-end Radio Software development: See how customer needs, requirements, design, development and testing shape software quality and customer experience. 
 Turn AI opportunities into practical solutions: Identify useful engineering applications and build prototypes or automation to address real challenges. 
 Improve software quality and delivery: Explore how AI, data, continuous integration and test automation can support development, verification and early quality assurance. 
 Connect engineering with customer and business outcomes: Learn how technical decisions can affect quality, customer satisfaction, delivery time, cost and risk.

You are interested in telecommunications, software and AI, and want to understand how technology can solve real problems.  In addition, you have: 
  A recent master’s degree in Telecommunications, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering or a related field. 
 Knowledge of wireless communication, mobile networks or radio technology, with an interest in how communication systems work. 
 Software development knowledge and hands-on programming experience, preferably in Python, C/C++ or a similar language.

 Curiosity, initiative and the ability to learn independently and adapt to new ideas. 
 Clear communication and collaboration skills, including working with people from different technical and cultural backgrounds. 
 An inclusive, global mindset and interest in contributing across teams and locations. 
 Analytical problem-solving skills and a practical, hands-on approach. 
 Excellent written and spoken English, with accountability and interest in the wider impact of your work.

 Advanced level of English.
